facts.name: Role family
facts.definition: The primary engineering or product role family named by the job.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract the primary role family from the title and responsibilities.

facts.name: Applied AI scope
facts.definition: How directly the role builds, evaluates, or operates AI-enabled product capabilities.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract explicit AI responsibilities and the systems or product outcomes they support.

facts.name: Product and customer scope
facts.definition: The role's direct interaction with product decisions, users, or customers.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract explicit product ownership, user research, customer, or stakeholder responsibilities.

facts.name: Ownership and impact scope
facts.definition: The decisions, delivery scope, and measurable outcomes owned by the role.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract explicit ownership language and expected business, user, or technical outcomes.

facts.name: Infrastructure scope
facts.definition: How much of the role is limited to general platform or infrastructure work without an applied AI outcome.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract platform, reliability, data, model-serving, and application responsibilities without inferring unstated allocation.

facts.name: Work arrangement
facts.definition: The location, remote, hybrid, onsite, and travel terms stated by the job.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract explicit available work modes and locations as a list of normalized values.

facts.name: Compensation
facts.definition: The salary range and other compensation terms stated by the job.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract stated base salary, variable compensation, equity, and currency without estimating missing values.

facts.name: Work authorization requirement
facts.definition: Any explicit employment authorization, citizenship, clearance, or sponsorship requirement.
facts.extraction_instructions: Extract explicit allowed authorization, citizenship, clearance, and sponsorship paths as a list of normalized values.

dimensions.name: Role family fit
dimensions.definition: Whether the role belongs to an AI engineering, applied science, or AI product family.

dimensions.name: Applied AI depth
dimensions.definition: The depth of responsibility for building and evaluating AI-enabled behavior in a product or workflow.

dimensions.name: Product and customer proximity
dimensions.definition: How directly the role shapes product decisions and learns from users or customers.

dimensions.name: Ownership and impact
dimensions.definition: The degree of end-to-end ownership and measurable impact expected from the role.
examples: Own delivery from discovery through launch

dimensions.name: Pure infrastructure concentration
dimensions.definition: The degree to which the role is limited to general infrastructure without a stated applied AI or product outcome.
examples: Build a general compute platform only
Operate model serving for a user-facing feature

dimensions.name: Work arrangement
dimensions.definition: The explicit work-location and attendance terms available for comparison with confirmed preferences.

dimensions.name: Compensation
dimensions.definition: The explicit compensation information available for comparison with confirmed requirements.

dimensions.name: Work authorization
dimensions.definition: Whether explicit authorization requirements conflict with confirmed candidate facts.

questions.question: Does the role directly shape a product or interact with users or customers?
Does the role build, evaluate, or operate AI capabilities tied to a concrete product or workflow?
Is the role limited to general infrastructure without a stated applied AI or product outcome?
